backend_branch_check.result: No ANE-named or ANE-targeting branch appeared in the direct upstream branch-list responses for mlx, mlx-lm, or mlx-examples. This is limited to visible upstream heads returned by the API; it does not prove no fork or deleted branch has ever existed.

documented_mlx_targets.finding: README states current device support is CPU and GPU. It does not list ANE.

device_distinctions.gpu_metal: MLX #928 and #1670 discussion about Metal, CUDA, quantization, or fused SDPA must not be counted as ANE evidence.
device_distinctions.cpu_amx: No primary source in the covered MLX discussions establishes a CPU AMX backend or equates CPU AMX with ANE. Do not infer ANE execution from CPU execution or AMX terminology.
device_distinctions.ane: The repeated maintainer position is that upstream MLX has no ANE device/backend; Core ML use described by users is outside an MLX ANE backend.

compiler_opportunities.opportunity: Keep a source-native ANE/MIL compiler as an external target rather than an MLX backend integration.
compiler_opportunities.basis: Upstream maintainer statements repeatedly close ANE requests without a backend plan; no visible upstream ANE branch was found.
compiler_opportunities.scope: Do not claim MLX support or create an MLX adapter absent a public supported device API.

compiler_opportunities.opportunity: Prioritize inference-only, FP16 binary and static-shape graph lowering with explicit unsupported-op diagnostics.
compiler_opportunities.basis: This matches the user-proposed Core ML/ANE boundary in #18, but the hardware properties are user speculation rather than an upstream commitment.
compiler_opportunities.scope: Validate only against real ANE/Core ML behavior before describing it as capability.

compiler_opportunities.opportunity: Design a narrow interop boundary for exported/partitioned inference graphs, not a fake device selection in MLX.
compiler_opportunities.basis: #18 community proposal puts MLX-side work around Core ML execution; upstream does not endorse an MLX-native ANE path.
compiler_opportunities.scope: A future integration needs a reproducible MLX graph-export contract and an explicit ownership/lifetime contract for shared buffers.

compiler_opportunities.opportunity: Keep GPU/CUDA quantization and SDPA optimization separate from ANE lowering.
compiler_opportunities.basis: Maintainer #1670 comments identify MLX-LM KV-cache and possible fused-SDPA work, while the later FP8 comment names CUDA.
compiler_opportunities.scope: Do not use their performance claims as ANE benchmarks or ANE feature requirements.

limitations: No hardware access, experiment-module execution, GPU, CPU-AMX, or ANE benchmarking was performed.
Direct GitHub search was rate/abuse limited for some repeated queries; primary seed and targeted related material was fetched directly and all missed search coverage is recorded.
No assertion is made about private, deleted, fork-only, or unindexed experimental branches.
